title: Albany opening is paperwork and compact tuples before the farm
body:
The Albany opening is **registration / oath / report / ready-made setup** plus **compact tuples and a legend** before the player sees Cade’s farm or a wolf. Goal is understood; the first hour still feels like a dispatch form.

Grok-4.6 MCP wave: **14** `bugs[]` rows on paperwork/tuples; **9** worst-moments named Rowan-to-oath before the yard; 53 verdicts mentioned paperwork/bureaucracy. Enjoyment 2.89, would-replay 4/82.

Fix: get a first-time player onto a readable place and a wolf problem faster. Keep civic choices, but do not front-load three stacked menus and machine tuples as the first scene.

Evidence: grok-4.6 instant-thinking wave, 82 completed interviews, build `fe2619a8`.

evidence.summary: Grok-4.6 MCP wave cluster (14 mentions, 82 completed interviews).
